families.name: normalized-lag-momentum
families.rule: Compare current price with price lag ticks ago. Abstain unless absolute change exceeds threshold times mean absolute one-tick change over the last 20 changes times square root of lag. Trend follows change; reverse opposes it.

families.name: normalized-price-sma-distance
families.rule: Compare current price with the simple moving average including current price. Abstain unless absolute difference exceeds threshold times mean absolute one-tick change over the last 20 changes times square root of window. Trend follows difference; reverse opposes it.

families.name: normalized-tick-streak
families.rule: Require length consecutive strictly same-sign one-tick changes. Abstain unless absolute change across the streak exceeds threshold times mean absolute one-tick change over the last 20 changes times square root of length. Trend follows streak; reverse opposes it.

families.name: normalized-sma-spread
families.rule: Compare fast and slow simple moving averages, both including current price. Abstain unless absolute spread exceeds threshold times mean absolute one-tick change over the last 20 changes times square root of slow period. Trend follows spread; reverse opposes it.

families.name: relative-tick-impulse
families.rule: Abstain unless current absolute one-tick change is strictly greater than threshold times the mean absolute change over the last window changes, including current. Trend follows the change; reverse opposes it.

timing.resetAt: every missing tick and chronological split boundary
timing.noCrossing: decision, delayed entry and settlement stay in the same contiguous segment

ranking.rankOn: minimum modeled signed return over all four diagnostics and all three delays at primary payout; underpowered candidates rank last
ranking.developmentPass: All four diagnostics positive at every delay under the stress payout, plus all sample floors. Never a trading approval.

limitations: These are 500 correlated rule variants across five families, not 500 independent discoveries.
Both data series and the previous 50-method results were viewed before this catalog was written. All scores are adaptive retrospective development evidence, not untouched validation.
The prior two-week study is contained in the 30-day archive and is not double-counted.
The pilot composite includes 220 seconds recovered historically after the live cutoff; the original incomplete live pilot remains unchanged.
Public tick prices, assumed payouts and fixed processing delays do not establish executable Deriv Bot conditions or platform timing parity.
